findings.explanation: The new IssueBulkUpdateDateEndpoint.post() is gated by allow_permission([ROLE.ADMIN, ROLE.MEMBER]), which only verifies that the requester is an active member of the project identified by the URL's slug/project_id. However, the issues to be updated are fetched purely by user-supplied IDs: `issues = list(Issue.objects.filter(id__in=issue_ids))` (line 1103). There is no filter tying each issue to the workspace slug or project_id from the URL. A MEMBER of project A can therefore pass issue IDs belonging to project B (or any other workspace) and have their start_date/target_date modified via `Issue.objects.bulk_update(issues_to_update, ...)` (line 1162). This is an IDOR: the object is fetched by a user-controlled identifier without verifying the requester owns it or is allowed to access it.
findings.suggested_fix: Scope the issue lookup to the URL's workspace and project, e.g. `Issue.objects.filter(id__in=issue_ids, workspace__slug=slug, project_id=project_id)`, so only issues belonging to the authorized project can be updated.
